symptom: `describe page` omitted a combo box's `customEditability` / `customEditabilityExpression` and a data grid text/number filter's `defaultValue` expression and `delay`, though exec stored them (bson dump shows `Expression: $currentObject/Locked`); the report's own generic widget (`entitypicker … Placeholder:`) and its MDL-WIDGET06 "not yet persisted" warning reproduce only on the pre-#1578 binary
cause: Widgets with a dedicated describe reader (isKnownCustomWidgetType) never ran extractExplicitProperties, and only Data grid 2 and Gallery had been given the by-key reader (#1573); the combo box and filter branch printed its keyword set and nothing else. Separately, nonDefaultPropsByKey compared with the schema DefaultValue, but exec writes the embedded template's value for an absent property — combo box readOnlyStyle is `bordered` in the template against a default of `text`
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_bykey.go` (sharedBranchByKeySkip, templateWrittenDefaults, extractSharedBranchByKeyProps, withoutUndescribedComboBoxModes), `cmd_pages_describe_parse.go`, `cmd_pages_describe_output.go` (generic branch no longer claims a known widget with explicit props), `widget_known_props_from_mpk.go` + `validate_widgets.go` (enrichKnownPropertiesFromTemplates for check without -p)
insight: Retest an old report against a pre-fix worktree before theorising: the reporter's exact shape was already fixed a day earlier, and only a probe on SHIPPED widgets with dedicated readers found what was still live. Compare by-key values with what exec writes when the key is absent (the template object), not the schema default — the corpus diff against a baseline build showed Studio Pro's own Administration combo boxes store `readOnlyStyle: text`, which describe omitted and an edit-replay would have flipped to `bordered`. Settings of a mode DESCRIBE does not spell (combo box database/static) are named in a NOT re-executable note, not printed into a combo box of another mode. And a key describe prints must pass `check` WITHOUT -p too: the hand-crafted defs only learn the widget's keys from the project's .mpk, so the embedded template now stands in when there is none.
